description: Vivo and iQOO phones running Funtouch OS or OriginOS.

packages.name: Vivo Browser
packages.breaks: If it is your default browser, pick another first.

packages.name: vivo.com
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Jovi Home
packages.what: The page left of the home screen.
packages.breaks: The Jovi Home page disappears.

packages.name: Lock-screen poster
packages.what: Rotating lock-screen wallpapers with promoted content.
packages.breaks: The lock-screen wallpaper stops rotating.

packages.name: Compass
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: V-Appstore
packages.breaks: Vivo's own apps stop updating through V-Appstore.

packages.name: EasyShare
packages.breaks: EasyShare transfers are unavailable.

packages.name: Email
packages.breaks: Mail accounts set up in this app stop notifying you.

packages.name: Weather
packages.breaks: Weather widgets go blank.

packages.name: i Music
packages.breaks: Music files open in another player.

packages.name: Clock
packages.breaks: Alarms you have set will not ring.

packages.name: i Theme
packages.breaks: You cannot change theme or wallpaper from Settings.

packages.name: S-capture
packages.breaks: Long screenshots and screen recording stop working.

packages.name: Jovi assistant
packages.breaks: Smart suggestions and some reminders stop.

packages.name: Game Centre
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away. Rated caution because the package name was not checked on a device.

packages.name: App clone
packages.what: Runs a second copy of chat apps.

packages.name: FM radio
packages.breaks: FM radio is unavailable.

packages.name: Vivo community
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away. Rated caution because the package name was not checked on a device.

packages.name: Albums
packages.breaks: The camera's preview button and photo pickers in other apps may break.

packages.name: Vivo Cloud
packages.breaks: Cloud sync and backup stop.

packages.name: Vivo account
packages.breaks: Account features break, including Find Phone.

packages.name: Find Phone
packages.what: Locate or lock a lost phone.
